title: Danielmas Mod 2
description: A mod that swaps the inventories of players at a certain interval.
body:
**The Second Danielmas Mod**

Mod for multiplayer that adds a command to swap player's inventories at a certain interval. The command is /swapinv, with it having subcommands to start, stop, and change the interval. By default the interval is 60 seconds. The minimum is 5 secs.

It can be used for your friends as a fun challenge on a server or in a more sadistic light (torturous and arduous attempt at beating the game) depending on the friend group.
